initializer.interpretation: After first-cycle store current=40 is readable in the four all-stage cases. At the second initializer call and return-before-store, current has no displayValue and is unavailable; the old 40 is hidden. After second-cycle store current=41 is available. Both same-line cases keep ready[0]=9 and ready[1]=4 available at all six inspected stops. The no-first-cycle-queries cases intentionally omit a current=40 read.
